caption:
"Comment HARVEY for the repo" 🙄 It's free and public. Here's what it is.

Harvey is an open-source sales agent that runs on Claude Code on your own computer:
1. Finds local businesses
2. Checks their website and scores them
3. Writes a personal cold email
4. Waits for YOU to approve every send

Runs on your Claude plan, no API bill. Cold email has rules in most countries: use business addresses, say who you are, include an unsubscribe link.

Found in my own saved reels and sorted by SaveSort. Sort yours free, link in bio.

#claudeai #aiagents #sidehustle #coldemail
